rules: When the canonical story, character, world, and chapter package is approved for production planning.
When the storyboard, shot timing, continuity ledger, and visual requirements are ready for image production.
When storyboard work reveals a canon, pacing, or continuity decision that requires showrunner resolution.
When visual feasibility, continuity, or frame coverage requires a storyboard adjustment before final assembly.
When the approved visual frame package, character references, and continuity notes are complete for voice and motion assembly.
When speech assets, subtitles, motion assembly, and final video QA are complete and the coordinator needs the delivery package.
